worker_registration.prior_defect: A single kubectl wait invocation refused immediately when the GPU node resource did not yet exist.
worker_registration.correction: A bounded gate now polls until the exact two CPU and one GPU resources both exist and are Ready, refuses excess capacity, and emits only a sanitized reason code on failure.

cleanup_invocation.prior_defect: The runner invoked a mode-0644 cleanup source directly.
cleanup_invocation.correction: The hash-bound runner invokes the cleanup source explicitly through bash; executable file mode is no longer an unbound runtime dependency.

cleanup_receipts.prior_defect: An automatic cleanup refusal produced no immediate cleanup-stage receipt.
cleanup_receipts.correction: The cleanup source persists an immutable INCOMPLETE receipt at its exact failing step and supports a separate cleanup_recovery receipt without overwriting history.

terraform_secret_disable.prior_defect: Policy evaluation indexed a count-zero secret during the disabled cleanup plan.
terraform_secret_disable.correction: The policy data source keeps its stable state address and uses a deterministic, unused fallback ARN only while the policy resource itself has count zero.

terraform_worker_drift.prior_defect: The targeted cleanup graph proposed resetting temporary CPU desired capacity before the ordered worker cleanup stage.
terraform_worker_drift.correction: The CPU managed node group now ignores desired-size drift, matching the existing GPU rule; the bounded runner and deadline controller remain the only window capacity controls.

prewindow_zero_state.correction: The runner now refuses before worker scale-up if CPU/GPU nodes, synthetic pods, the window Ingress, the window controller, or the DRA DaemonSet already exist.

synthetic_token_binding.correction: The runner verifies the retained local token's exact path, mode, byte length, and SHA-256 against packet-006 evidence before any AWS mutation, without reading or logging the secret value.

canonical_pytest.warning_note: Known Starlette TestClient deprecation warning; no test failure.

next_boundary: Prepare packet 2026-009 with exact source hashes. Independent review and a new owner approval are mandatory before any AWS or Kubernetes retry.
